about: ShelfSage benchmark (fixed before the LLM planner was written, so the prompt is not tuned to it). Every task starts from the reset scene. goal: conditions on the final world (book ids; 'at' = 'Table X' or a compartment); books not named in the goal must stay where they were. expect: find (plan looks the book up), verify [book, target, answer] (plan checks it, the answer is right), refuse (no action may run). Failure tasks: 'inject' is applied once just before the first plan step matching 'before' (sim/failures.py); the planner may plan again after the failure (planner/replan.py). The failure tasks were made concrete in Phase 9, before any planner ran them (see their notes). Goal ids: see scene/library_meta.json. Spatial answers were computed from the world model (planner/world.py) on 2026-11-22: empty compartment nearest the window = S3-A4 (2.69 m, next S3-B3 2.83 m); table nearest the window = F (1.55 m, next C 2.48 m); S2-A1 holds Physics, Kinematics, Dynamics from the left; tables with the fewest books = D and F (1 each).

categories.single: one book, template wording (the baseline's home ground)
categories.multi: several books or steps in one command
categories.phrasing: a single move worded naturally (synonyms, partial titles, descriptions of the target)
categories.spatial: the book or the target is given by a spatial relation or a property
categories.query: questions: where is a book, is it somewhere
categories.infeasible: cannot or must not be done: the planner has to refuse, nothing may move
categories.failure: a failure is injected while executing; the robot must recover (Phase 9)
